product.description: 31.5”W x 15.75”D x 31.7”H Solid ash frame and legs are complemented by hardwood doors with ash veneer A handsome piece that can anchor a modern, rustic or transitional style room or hallway Display photos or a vase of flowers on top; store books or other items inside Assembly in 15 minutes or less. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
